acceptanceCriteria: critical_path_test.go has one regression per code (PREREQUISITE_UNSATISFIED, LOOP_DETECTED, ESCALATION_PENDING) asserting the node first-blocker code.
Each regression fails when the corresponding blocker is removed from the shared view.
The read stays pure (store bytes identical before and after).
body: V1-0793 acceptance criterion 4 says execution prerequisites and LOOP_DETECTED/ESCALATION_PENDING holds appear as critical-path node blockers. At 618680492cf8 (#574) they surface through the shared blocker view, but internal/tasks/cli/critical_path_test.go has no case that builds such a node and checks its first blocker code. Found during the #588 closeout assessment (2026-10-05).
title: corvint-tasks: critical-path lacks regressions for PREREQUISITE_UNSATISFIED, LOOP_DETECTED and ESCALATION_PENDING node blockers (issue #588 follow-up)
